pool.text: The Meirindō school of classic Confucian Chinese learning was established in Kumemura.
Perry's expeditionary squadron stopped in Naha en route to Tokyo.
Naha became the capital city after the replacement of the Ryūkyū Kingdom.
The Ryūkyū Domain was abolished and fully annexed by Japan as Okinawa Prefecture.
An Imperial decree established Naha as an open port for trading with Western nations.
The modern city of Naha was officially founded on May 20th.
Shuri Castle was almost destroyed by the US Marines, Army and Navy.
The village of Oroku was merged into the city of Naha.
Honolulu in the United States established a sister city relationship with Naha.
A specific academic work was submitted to the University of Hawaii.
Nichinan in Miyazaki established a sister city connection with Naha.
São Vicente in Brazil established an official partnership connection with Naha.
Fuzhou in China established a sister city relationship with Naha.
Naha City was prominently featured in the plot of the film The Karate Kid Part II.
The area formerly used for United States military housing was released to Okinawa.
Kawasaki in Kanagawa established a sister city connection with Naha.
The opening scene of David Mitchell's novel Ghostwritten is set in Naha.
The name Naha was utilized in Microsoft's space simulation video game Freelancer.
The Okinawa Prefectural Museum opened in the area in front of Shintoshin Park.
PBS series Family Ingredients filmed two episodes at Shuri Castle and Makishi Market.
